title: Forgiveness
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tells the prodigal son in order (Luke 15:11-24) for a class drama and says its lesson on forgiveness.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the importance of obeying parents.
floor.question: Why obey parents?
floor.answer: God commands it (they care for us)

contexts: a friend who returns after a fight

board.do: Write: went away, wasted, pigs, came home.
Wait for the child to say he forgave him.

misconceptions.ask: What did the father do when his son came home?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 15:20-24 and act it out.

misconceptions.ask: Which son went to a distant country?
misconceptions.repair: Two name cards: younger went away, elder stayed.

misconceptions.ask: What animals did the son feed?
What is the main lesson of the prodigal son?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: what did the father do? The lesson is there.

checks.question: What did the younger son do with his share?
checks.answer: Wasted it in a distant country

checks.question: What is the lesson of the story?
